slno: Serial number or row identifier for the record
order_receipt_date: Date when the sales order was received by the organization
so_delivery_date: Planned or committed delivery date for the sales order
mktg_specialistsmanagers: Name or ID of the marketing specialist or manager handling the order
type_of_order: Category or classification of the order (e.g., standard, custom)
product_: Name or identifier of the product being ordered
opp_id: Opportunity ID from the CRM system (e.g., Salesforce)
ion_number: Internal Order Notification number or identifier for the order initiation process
work_order_number: Unique identifier for the work order in production
ion_meeting__date_planned: Planned date for the initial order notification (ION) kickoff meeting
ion_meeting__date_actual: Actual date when the ION kickoff meeting occurred
ion_meeting_delay_days: Number of days delay between planned and actual ION meeting dates
bom_updated_along_with_drawings_planned_: Planned date for updating the Bill of Materials (BOM) along with engineering drawings
bom_updated_along_with_drawings_actual: Actual date when BOM and drawings were updated
bom_delay_days: Number of days delay in BOM and drawings update
wo_release_date_planned: Planned date for releasing the work order to production
wo_release_date_actual: Actual date when the work order was released
wo_release_delay_days: Number of days delay in work order release
mrf_raised_planned: Planned date for raising the Material Requisition Form (MRF)
mrf_raised_actual: Actual date when the MRF was raised
mrf_raised_delay_days: Number of days delay in raising the MRF
indent_raised_planned: Planned date for raising the purchase indent (requisition for procurement)
indent_raised_actual: Actual date when the purchase indent was raised
indent_raised_delay_days: Number of days delay in raising the purchase indent
purchase_end_date_planned: Planned end date for the procurement or purchase process
purchase_end_date_actual: Actual end date for the purchase process
purchase_delay_days: Number of days delay in completing the purchase process
production_planned_date_planned: Planned start date for production planning
production_planned_date_actual: Actual start date for production planning
production_planned_delay_days: Number of days delay in production planning start
qa_clearance__planned: Planned date for Quality Assurance (QA) clearance or approval
qa_clearance__actual: Actual date when QA clearance was obtained
qa_clearance_delay_days: Number of days delay in QA clearance
product_dispatch_date_planned: Planned date for dispatching the product from the factory
product_dispatch_date_actual: Actual date when the product was dispatched
product_dispatch_delay_days: Number of days delay in product dispatch
pdi_date_at_factory_planned: Planned date for Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) at the factory
pdi_date_at_factory_actual: Actual date of PDI conducted at the factory
delivery_date_planned: Planned date for delivery to the customer
onsite_pdi_date_planned: Planned date for onsite Pre-Delivery Inspection at customer location
installation_date_actual: Actual date when installation was completed
payment_received_actual: Actual date when payment was received
status: Current status of the order (e.g., pending, completed, delayed)
year: Year associated with the order or record
source_filename: Name of the source file from which the data was extracted
rowuniqueid: Unique identifier for the row in the dataset
